schema_version.description: Schema version of the artifact; bumped on breaking ABI changes.

mode.description: Canonical run mode: ask and plan are read-only, agent writes. Strategy controls are separate schema-owned fields, never modes.

effective_access.description: Access profile enforced by the engine.

external_context_policy.description: Requested web policy for the run.

effective_web_mode.description: Web policy actually executed by the selected route.

final_attempt_id.description: Attempt whose output became the final answer/patch; null when no attempt succeeded.

policy.description: Requested web policy for the run.

effective_mode.description: Policy actually executed by the harness route (disclosed upgrades, e.g. cached to live).

attempted.description: Whether any web activity was attempted.

satisfied.description: Completed without a typed failure; verification records retrieval-proof strength.

status.description: Observed web activity: none, attempted, satisfied, failed, or unverified.

verification.description: Retrieval-proof strength of observed web activity: verified (typed successful retrieval; content proven), dispatched (operation completed but no typed retrieval outcome; content not proven), or none.

tool.description: Web tool that produced the evidence, when any.

target.description: Target (query/url) of the web activity as issued, when any.

error_summary.description: Redacted error detail when web activity failed.

web.description: Run-level web evidence: the final attempt's evidence, else the most severe attempt evidence.

scope.description: All text input items in one native turn; separate instructions are excluded.

reported_source.description: Redacted credential source the vendor's startup frame reported.

request_refusal.description: Vendor-attested request refusal that stops retries and account rotation on its harness; input, executable and credential-source causes carry their own evidence.

anyOf.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

requested.description: Original effort preference before adaptation; null when none was requested.

submitted.description: Native option prepared for transport; null means omitted, never the explicit token none. Not proof of dispatch.

parameter.description: Native carrier, such as reasoning.effort, model_reasoning_effort or --effort; null when no separate knob is carried.

observed.description: Provider-reported effort only; null when unobserved, never copied from submission.

observedSource.description: Provider event/field that reported observed effort; null when unobserved.

reason.description: Diagnostic explanation; consumers branch on resolution, never prose.

anyOf.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

requested.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

submitted.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

submittedNative.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

reason.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

processing.description: Requested intent, submitted native control, and observed execution are independent facts. A submitted flag never proves observed service; mixed or missing session observations remain explicit.

nativeMode.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

debit.description: The route reports no actual cash or purchased-credit debit. Included service still admits the work, but its cash stays unknown instead of zero and is outside the finite cap; absence keeps proven ordinary inclusion as zero cash.

processing_cost_basis.description: Mode-qualified billing evidence for an existing cost record. Authentication alone does not establish included premium service; credits, cash, and token valuation stay distinct.

anyOf.description: Native prompt-cache lifetime for the main conversation and helper requests of a harness that declares it. Omission sends no override: native defaults, profile settings and the inherited environment stay in effect.

requested.description: Lifetime the engine routed to this session: the run's captured value where this adapter declares it, otherwise null (Default, or an undeclared value disclosed as ignored). The captured intent itself is the task contract's prompt_cache_ttl.

submitted.description: Value set on the native lifetime controls of this process, null when none was set. Configuration, not proof that the provider applied it.

reason.description: Known reason the submitted value cannot govern this session (a forcing or disabling native control in effect, or a CLI that predates the controls); null when none is known.

observed.description: Lifetime split of the cache writes reported by the native result usage; it does not establish which request buckets that usage aggregates. none = no observed writes (not disabled caching); unknown = a result did not report the split.

write_5m_tokens.description: Reported five-minute cache-write tokens summed over results; null when any result omitted the split.

write_1h_tokens.description: Reported one-hour cache-write tokens summed over results; null when any result omitted the split.

prompt_cache_ttl.description: Requested, configured and observed prompt-cache lifetime facts for one attempt. Lifecycle, outcome and cost are separate facts and never derive from this receipt.

cashKnowledge.description: Quality of incremental-cash cost evidence for an operation.

usage_cost.description: Observed usage components. An amount of unknown meaning is not charged cash; separately proven included service can still establish exact zero incremental cash unless its route reports no actual debit.

estimated_request_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the whole rendered request (chars/4, plus a fixed figure per image); never a tokenizer count.

model.description: Model whose catalog row was consulted; null when the producer reported none.

framing_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the request outside this packet; null when unmeasured.

selection_limit_tokens.description: Limit the optional selection honoured: the packet's share of the window, or the assumed ceiling on file contents.

omitted_for_budget.description: Optional files left out to honour selection_limit_tokens (listed in omissions).

mandatory_paths.description: Project mandatory files, each delivered complete in readable_files.

budget.description: Sizing evidence for a raw context packet; disclosed, never a tokenizer count.

raw_context.description: Size of the raw-api request this attempt last prepared, from the status event that try emitted just before its POST (#147); not proof the provider received it. Absent for other transports.

observed_model.description: Model the harness stream actually reported; null when never disclosed (rendered as unverified, never guessed).

label.description: The observed model string, byte-identical to observed_model on the same event and to the matched entry's catalog label.

id.description: Id of the only catalog entry whose label is exactly `label`; no other entry has `label` as its id.

source.description: The model list the spawn's own account answered before the vendor process ran.

profile_id.description: Credential profile whose catalog answered (the spawn's profile); null = engine-default credentials.

anyOf.description: Exact same-spawn catalog evidence mapping an observed model label to its listed id; never derived from the requested model, normalized or fuzzy-matched.

observed_model_catalog_match.description: Catalog proof carried by the same event that set observed_model, kept only while no later native try of the attempt started and no later event reported another model; null otherwise, even if a later try's event carried one.

anyOf.description: Auth mode a route runs under: a native local session, an API key, or unknown.

auth_mode.description: Auth route the attempt actually ran under (local_session subscription vs api_key), disclosed by the adapter's typed started payload; null when never disclosed (treated as unknown, never guessed).

anyOf.description: Concrete credential source used or probed by a harness.

auth_source.description: Concrete credential source the attempt disclosed (native_session/api_key_env/...); null when never disclosed.

profile_id.description: Credential profile the attempt actually ran under (adapter-stamped); null = engine default or undisclosed.

requested_model.description: Model hint the engine sent the attempt; null when the route ran on its default.

items.description: Preflight resolution of one requested capability on one selected harness lane.

request_requirements.description: Per-lane requested/effective capability receipts computed at preflight; never inferred by surfaces.

web.description: Typed web-evidence record computed by the orchestrator; surfaces project it and never re-derive evidence from raw events.

kind.description: Coarse tool classification used for typed governance; adapters map native tool names to a kind.

target.description: Target of the tool use as issued, when known.

recovered.description: True when a later successful result matches this failed invocation.

tool_use_id.description: Tool use id correlating the error to its call, when known.

items.description: One tool error observed during an attempt.

tool_errors.description: Tool errors, bounded by the writer (most recent first when truncated; tool_errors_total keeps the true count).

tool_errors_total.description: True total count of tool errors.

unrecovered_tool_errors.description: Tool errors with no later successful recovery.

statusless_tool_results.description: tool_result events that arrived without a status field (never treated as ok).

dropped_events.description: Native lines/events the adapter could not parse or did not recognize (never silently zero).

category.description: Typed failure category (GH #31) the retry policy and required-actions read; orthogonal to kind.

retryable.description: Whether the classified category is retryable (the centralized retry-policy gate).

retry_delay_ms.description: Suggested retry delay in milliseconds, when reported.

http_status.description: Vendor HTTP status code disclosed by the error, when any; null otherwise.

signal.description: Process termination signal (e.g. SIGKILL) when a crash killed the child; null otherwise.

adapter_code.description: Vendor/adapter error-category code passed verbatim as evidence; null when none.

items.description: An adapter-declared transient failure that informed bounded retry policy.

transient_failures.description: Adapter-declared transient failures that informed bounded retry policy.

deliverable_present.description: Whether the attempt produced the deliverable the intent asked for.

gates_passed.description: Whether deterministic gates passed; null when no gates ran.

web_required_unsatisfied.description: True when required web evidence was not satisfied.

delegation_belt_unavailable.description: True when --delegate requested the belt but the injected MCP server failed to become operational (QA-024); blocks a silent clean success.

tool_warnings_count.description: Count of tool warnings in the attempt.

status.description: Outcome of one attempt: success, success_with_warnings, blocked, or failed.

state.description: Folded work state: the WorkReport state, or unverified when no valid report was obtained (transport unsupported / lane gated, or an instructed footer missing or broken).

source.description: Provenance of a WorkReport: constrained (native schema transport), validated (instructed terminal metadata), or absent (no transport could carry one — a disclosed absence, not a failure).

kind.description: Category of a missing input a needs_input/incomplete report lists: a file, additional context, a credential, a permission, a human decision, or an external dependency.

locator.description: Concrete pointer to the missing thing (path/url/name); null when unnameable.

description.description: Human-readable description of what is needed and why.

items.description: One blocking input a needs_input/incomplete WorkReport lists.

required_inputs.description: Carried through from a needs_input/incomplete WorkReport for honest disclosure.

unverified_reason.description: Present only with state unverified on a validated (instructed footer) source: the disclosed cause of the missing report.

work_state.description: D-16 model-attested work outcome for the attempt (from its WorkReport), orthogonal to status; absent when the route has no work_report transport.

outcome.description: Contract/outcome truth for one attempt; tool errors are tracked separately from deliverable production.

requested.description: A Claudexor delegation belt MCP server was injected into this attempt's sandbox.

server_name.description: The injected belt MCP server name (as the harness reports it); null when unknown.

ready.description: The harness reported the injected belt MCP server as connected/ready.

failed.description: The harness reported the injected belt MCP server as failed to start.

tool_evidence.description: At least one belt tool (mcp__<server>__*) was actually invoked in this attempt.

delegation_belt.description: Runtime readiness receipt for the injected Claudexor delegation belt on one attempt (QA-024).

requested.description: The engine armed (injected) the browser MCP for this attempt.

server_name.description: The injected browser MCP server name; null when not armed.

attempted.description: At least one browser MCP tool call (matched to the injected server) occurred.

satisfied.description: At least one browser MCP tool call succeeded (trusted live-web activity).

failed.description: A browser MCP tool call failed and was not superseded by a success.

unused.description: The browser was armed but never called while generic web evidence satisfied the run (disclosure only; not a failure).

browser.description: Runtime browser-MCP evidence for one attempt (QA-040).

input_token_usage.description: Complete reported input total, including cache reads/writes, and its separately measured cache subsets. Null means unknown, never zero or a partial sum.

usage.description: Token usage summed from harness usage events; money is tracked separately in the budget ledger, not here. Each field is null until a harness reports it, so unreported never reads as 0. The relation between cached_input_tokens and input_tokens is harness-specific; do not derive a grand total.

items.description: Telemetry for one attempt: route evidence, web evidence, tool errors, dropped events, and outcome.

request_requirements.description: All selected-lane capability receipts for this run.

anyOf.description: Engine-owned Delegate requested/effective/used receipt; surfaces project it without parsing model output.

delegation.description: Run-level Delegate receipt aggregated from engine injection and typed tool evidence; null on legacy artifacts that did not record it.

tool_warnings_total.description: Sum of attempt tool warnings; rendered separately from terminal state.

usage_totals.description: Token usage summed from harness usage events; money is tracked separately in the budget ledger, not here. Each field is null until a harness reports it, so unreported never reads as 0. The relation between cached_input_tokens and input_tokens is harness-specific; do not derive a grand total.

requested.description: Preferred auth route: subscription (native/OAuth session), api_key (a stored API key), or auto (engine picks subscription-first with policy fallback). A preference, not a secret.

effective.description: Auth mode a route runs under: a native local session, an API key, or unknown.

source.description: Concrete credential source used or probed by a harness.

reason.description: Deterministic reason for the effective auth route: as_requested, native_first (auto, INV-061), no_native_session_fallback (auto downgraded to api_key), requested_route_unavailable (explicit preference contradicted), or undisclosed.

profile_id.description: Credential profile the deciding attempt ran under; null = engine-default credentials.

model_mismatch.description: Requested-vs-observed model mismatch on the deciding attempt; null when they match or either side is unknown.

auth_route.description: Auth route receipt: requested preference, disclosed effective route/source, deterministic reason, and the disclosing attempt; surfaces project it verbatim.

goal.description: Routing objective: pace expiring quota, choose the highest declared quality tier, or minimize incremental paid spend.

paid_fallback.description: When a route with incremental paid spend may be used.

dropped.description: Ids removed by paid_fallback or cooldown before ranking.

reason.description: Typed decisive reason the pool ranked the way it did (QA-034).

billing_knowledge.description: Effective billing knowledge used to rank it.

incremental_cost_usd.description: Known incremental cash cost, when any; null when unknown.

eligible.description: Whether the candidate survived paid_fallback/cooldown filtering.

items.description: Per-candidate billing/cost tuple in the routing rationale (QA-034).

anyOf.description: Typed routing rationale recorded once at pool ordering (QA-034).

routing_rationale.description: Typed routing rationale recorded once at pool ordering (QA-034); null on legacy artifacts or when no ranking was computed.

status.description: succeeded = reducer merged the scouts; failed = honest raw bundle; skipped = single report, no merge.

reducer_attempt_id.description: The reducer attempt id (roster/cost visible); null when no reducer attempt ran.

reason.description: Why the reducer failed or was skipped; null on a clean merge.

anyOf.description: Deep-scan reducer outcome: whether the scout reports were merged into a real synthesis, degraded to an honest raw bundle, or skipped as a single report.

deep_scan_synthesis.description: Deep-scan reducer outcome (#27); null on non-deep-scan/legacy runs.

noChanges.description: True when the run finished without changing any files (the ex no_op fact).

checks.description: Deterministic checks axis: configured project checks passed, failed, or none are configured (a named state, never a stand-in for review results).

review.description: Review axis: approved (clean cross-family verified review), blocked (open accepted findings), or not_run.

review_requested.description: Frozen model-review intent. False permits an honestly unreviewed result; absent historical records retain the review requirement.

anyOf.description: Typed reason qualifying a non-clean terminal; null on a clean success.

reason.description: Typed reason qualifying a non-clean terminal; null on a clean success.

work_state.description: D-16 model-attested work outcome, orthogonal to lifecycle; a needs_input/incomplete state vetoes applyability and exit 0. Absent on runs with no work_report transport.

outcome.description: Independent terminal outcome axes of a run (D8/D18).

present.description: Whether the canonical primary deliverable exists.

kind.description: Kind of canonical primary deliverable; null when none exists.

path.description: Run-relative path of the canonical primary deliverable; null when absent.

producer_attempt_id.description: Attempt that produced the deliverable, when known.

deliverable.description: Canonical primary-output presence and identity for a terminal run.

state.description: Terminal output readiness decided by the last valid output.ready receipt.

kind.description: Presentation kind of the terminal primary artifact.

path.description: Normalized run-relative path of the terminal primary artifact.

anyOf.description: Primary user-facing artifact selected once during terminal preparation.

primary.description: Selected terminal primary artifact, or null when the receipt announces readiness without a primary deliverable.

presentation.description: Immutable terminal output state and primary artifact. Absent only on legacy RunFacts receipts.

planners.description: Number of participants whose canonical role is planner.

attempt_id.description: Attempt id when the participant owns an orchestrator attempt; null for reviewer-panel members.

harness_id.description: Harness that served this participant role.

role.description: Canonical role of one participant in the terminal run graph.

deliverable_present.description: Whether this participant produced the deliverable its role requested.

anyOf.description: Terminal outcome recorded for one run participant.

status.description: Participant outcome when recorded; null for artifact-only reviewer membership.

items.description: One role-labelled participant in the terminal run graph.

participants.description: Terminal participant graph plus its planner-lane count.

configured.description: Whether the frozen task configured deterministic gates.

executed.description: Whether the terminal attempt executed the gate set.

state.description: Terminal state of the configured deterministic gate set.

receipt_attempt_id.description: Attempt whose gate receipt decides this projection; null when no gates executed.

gates.description: Canonical gate configuration and terminal receipt projection.

blocker_ids.description: Stable ids of accepted evidence-backed blocking findings.

review.description: Canonical terminal review verdict and blocking-finding identity.

eligible.description: True when the apply gate would accept this run's patch right now.

state.description: The gate's apply-eligibility classification (e.g. needs_review | not_verified | no_changes | ok) when known.

reason.description: The gate's refusal text when not eligible (null when eligible).

requiredAction.description: Honest guidance for what actually unblocks apply (typed operator decision, add gates, re-run, or nothing to apply).

anyOf.description: Derived apply-gate verdict for a run's WorkProduct (single producer in the delivery gate).

eligibility.description: Delivery-gate eligibility at terminalization; null when nothing is applyable.

operator_decision_present.description: Whether a valid operator decision was present when the receipt was finalized.

apply.description: Terminal apply eligibility and operator-decision state.

id.description: Stable machine id for a required operator action on a blocked terminal run.

detail.description: Human-readable guidance for this action (English-only, INV-141).

items.description: One typed required operator action derived from a run's terminal outcome facts.

required_actions.description: Typed actions required to unblock this terminal outcome.

generated_at.description: When this immutable terminal receipt was finalized.

anyOf.description: Validated immutable terminal facts for one run.

run_facts.description: Exact validated terminal receipt; null before terminalization or on legacy runs.

generated_at.description: When the telemetry artifact was generated.

RunTelemetry.description: Run telemetry artifact (final/telemetry.yaml), the single computed source of web/tool evidence; surfaces project it and never re-derive evidence from raw events.
